description: This file provides utility functions for creating Date objects with special handling for years in the 0-99 range, accounting for JavaScript's date constructor quirks.

methods.name: createDate(y, m, d, h, M, s, ms)
methods.description: Creates a Date object with given year, month, day, hour, minute, second, and millisecond, handling years 0-99 correctly.

methods.name: createUTCDate(y)
methods.description: Creates a UTC Date object with given arguments, handling years 0-99 correctly.
